title: Mr. Hayes and his strict dress rules at Hayes' Chicken Shack
summary: White and black patrons alike needed collar, tie and jacket at Hayes' place.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Getting back to, I'm saying laws and things, but you had white kids coming down to this black lounge. Black, right, right. And listening to, were there any problems there? No problem.

Mr. Hayes would not have anything like that. Mr. Hayes was the owner of Hayes' chicken shack. Oh, boy. Mr. Hayes was the owner of the house. He was a damn good business man, and he made sure that anybody who came in, you had to have collar and tie and a jacket on. You didn't come in there with no T-shirt on. That's right, white or black.
